pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/src/lib/dev/locate.ts:46 The inspector silently presents an innermost library implementation as the call site when no product ancestor exists.

techniques.evidence: apps/desktop/src/lib/dev/inspector.tsx:59 Copies only the location, without a visible-text anchor or secondary implementation location; rejection reports failure but provides neither legacy copy nor selected-text fallback.

apps/desktop/scripts/dev-source-loc.mjs:27 The transform infers the root from the last /src/ segment instead of requiring a caller-supplied relative path; emitted src/... references omit this repository's apps/desktop/ prefix.

apps/desktop/src/lib/dev/locate.ts:46 An entirely library-owned chain selects its innermost entry; the standard requires the outermost stamped ancestor and an explicit warning that no product call site was found.
apps/desktop/src/lib/dev/locate.ts:38 Resolution follows standard DOM parent links and authored stamp attributes without consulting framework debug metadata.

apps/desktop/vite.config.ts:97 The helper is statically imported and its plugin registered unconditionally, violating registration-level gating; the internal flag check, lazy Babel import, and DEV overlay mounts satisfy only the other gates.

apps/desktop/src/lib/dev/inspector.tsx:209 Idle and hovering an element with no stamped ancestor render the same invitation; partial ancestor fallback is unlabelled, and the armed state has no automatic timeout.
